versions.subject: Merge PR #4784 from @tomaszdyduch - Add new DarkGate activity related rule
versions.detection:
selection_filename_suffix:
    TargetFilename|contains: ':\temp\'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
        - '.au3'
        - '\autoit3.exe'
selection_image_suffix:
    Image|contains: ':\temp\'
    Image|endswith:
        - '.au3'
        - '\autoit3.exe'
condition: 1 of selection_*
